consumption.col_what: Gate, then the commands run under it
consumption.commands_help: A gate is a named lock (lint, test, e2e…): one command holds it at a time, the others wait their turn. Each gate line adds up the commands run under it; each command line folds its arguments (specs, packages) in. Asked counts the runs that asked for the gate, ran those that ran to their end.

consumption.legend_djinn_all: Dashed: Djinn with everything it started (window, the Djinn's agent, workers, gates)
consumption.legend_djinn_self: Dotted: Djinn's own process alone (djinn up)

inbox.block_title: From the inbox, by the source of {source}
inbox.cannot_title: The source {source} cannot run on this machine
inbox.cannot_will: While it cannot run, what it reads no longer comes here. Once its skill is fixed, Djinn runs it again on its own and this card goes.
inbox.detail: What waits for you outside any wish. Nothing is made until you choose, and Djinn never answers a source.
inbox.dismissed: Dismissed: it will not be proposed again.
inbox.effect_dismiss: It will not come back here; nothing is said or marked at the source.
inbox.effect_file: Its lead receives it as a block and decides; nothing starts by itself.
inbox.effect_new: The wish starts with this item in its blocks; its lead plans the work.
inbox.effect_queue: Three wishes are active: it waits paused, and starts once you resume it.
inbox.effect_skill: Its lead follows the skill from the start.
inbox.effect_swap: “{pause}” is paused, keeping everything, to make room; the new wish starts at once.
inbox.effect_watch: Its watcher starts at once and tells the lead each change; workers, and so tokens, only when the lead starts them.
inbox.failing_title: The source {source} fails on this machine
inbox.failing_will: While it fails, what it reads no longer comes here. Djinn runs it again every {every} on its own; the first run that goes well takes this card away.
inbox.fix: Fix the cause on this machine
inbox.fix_effect: The error above says what failed: a tool to log in to, a command missing or one the project does not allow. Nothing to click: the next run sees the fix.
inbox.fix_skill_effect: The error above names what Djinn cannot read in the skill's SKILL.md. Djinn reads the skills again each minute.
inbox.project_detail: Djinn waits for you on its configuration: its panel says what, and what settles each thing.
inbox.plug_detail: Runs this command every {every} on this machine, logged in by its own tool; each item it prints becomes a card in the inbox.
inbox.plugged_toast: {source} is plugged in: its command runs from now on.
inbox.state_failing.other: Failing since {when}: {count} failed runs in a row
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.unplug_detail: Stops this command on this machine; the items it brought stay.
inbox.unplug_effect: Its command stops and this card goes; the items it brought stay. Its project's panel plugs it in again.
inbox.unplugged_toast: {source} is unplugged: its command runs no more.
inbox.will_file: If you hand it to Djinn, it goes as a block to “{wish}”, whose lead reads it and decides.
inbox.will_new: If you hand it to Djinn, a new wish takes it on: its lead reads it and plans the work.
inbox.will_none: Djinn found nowhere to send it: dismiss it, or hand it to a wish's lead yourself.
inbox.will_skill: If you hand it to Djinn, a wish takes it on with the skill {skill}, which its lead follows.
inbox.will_watch: If you hand it to Djinn, a wish follows it with the skill {skill}: its watcher starts at once, and its lead, told of each change, decides the work.

load.forecast_finishing.other: {count} above the limit finish their run
load.lower_finishes: Lowering the load lets the workers above its limit finish their run (Auto, or Windows, where a worker cannot pause); new tasks wait until fewer run.
load.lower_pauses: Lowering the load pauses the newest workers above its limit, and new tasks wait; the paused ones resume first once a slot frees. Investigators, corrections, reviews and workers started by hand finish their run; a worker holding a gate pauses once it lets it go.
load.forecast_memory: Memory: {engaged} of {total} may be engaged; {used} used now
load.label: Operating load
load.overclock_risk: Risk: Djinn will saturate CPU and memory; other applications may slow down or be terminated.
load.tooltip.auto: Auto: follows the load of the programs outside Djinn, never Djinn's own work nor your presence: one level down when that load stays high for 2 minutes, one level up towards {chosen} when it stays low for 10.
load.tooltip.high: High: up to {workers} workers, 80 % of the memory Djinn may engage, standard CPU priority.
load.tooltip.max: Max: up to {workers} workers, 100 % of the memory Djinn may engage, standard CPU priority.
load.tooltip.medium: Medium: up to {workers} workers, 50 % of the memory Djinn may engage, low CPU priority.
load.tooltip.minimal: Minimal: up to {workers} workers, 20 % of the memory Djinn may engage, low CPU priority.
load.tooltip.overclock: Overclock: up to {workers} workers, 150 % of the memory Djinn may engage, standard CPU priority.

project.no_sources: No skill of this project declares a source.
project.notice_decline_effect: It runs nothing on this machine, and the project stops asking.

project.pull_running: A pull is running: wait for it to end
project.push_held: Push held: its push checks are red
project.push_running: A push is running: wait for it to end
project.push_standard_detail: Pushes at an azima's end or after 3 tasks and an hour.
project.push_up_to_date_detail: Nothing to push: {remote}/{target} holds this branch already

project.reference_where: Written as main_branch in your own file, never in the repository. A team that follows another branch names it in its .agents/settings.txtpb, for everyone.
project.settings_detail: What the project's workers get when a task names nothing else. Your file wins over the team's, setting by setting.
project.skill_know_how: Know-how for the workers: no wish template, inbox source nor babysit for Djinn.
project.skill_to_fix: Djinn cannot use all of it: see “To fix”.

project.sync_landed: Landed: main holds its commits already, nothing to push
project.tip: A folder outside Git works too. From a terminal: {command}
project.watch_commands_detail: A watcher runs its command without review: one that .agents/permissions.txtpb lists, one a skill of this project declares, or one you allow here, for yourself. A command you allow, or one that starts with it, runs; it is kept in your own settings, never in the repository.

settings.language_detail: The interface follows the system language unless you choose one.

settings.shortcut_unavailable: Only in Djinn's window, on a system that has global shortcuts.
settings.text_size_detail: Scales the whole window, its spacing with its text. Smaller sizes show more at once.
settings.theme_detail: How the window looks. As the system by default.

wish.lead_seat_move: Moves the Djinn here: its next batch starts here, with its journal
wish.lead_seats_detail: Move the Djinn to another agent, model or account: its next batch starts there, and it stays there
wish.lead_ended: The Djinn ended (code {code}): its tab keeps its last output. Talk to the Djinn starts it again
wish.lead_failed: The Djinn could not start: {error}. Talk to the Djinn tries again
wish.lead_missing: {command} is not installed on this machine
wish.lead_new: Starts the Djinn anew on this agent, from the brief
wish.lead_recorded: The Djinn's agent: resumes it, focused on this wish
wish.no_tasks: No task yet: the Djinn plans them.
wish.pause_detail: Set this wish aside: its workers stop, and start again when you resume it.
wish.principal_detail: The principal wish: the Djinn coordinates from it and receives there the answers of the other wishes.
wish.push_held: The push is held: its checks are red
wish.push_held_corrected: The push is held, corrected by {task}
wish.push_refused: The remote refused the last push: Djinn asks you
wish.ready_title: Djinn proposes to grant this wish. Only you can.
wish.resume_detail: Opens the Djinn's terminal, focused on this wish
wish.strategy_wish_detail: One integration branch per wish and project.
wish.title: Title
work.no_identity: git has no identity to sign Djinn's merges and commits: run git config --global user.name "Your Name" and git config --global user.email you@example.com (or the same without --global, in the project's repository)
update.no_answer: Djinn did not answer within {seconds} s: try again
update.no_restart: Djinn did not restart within {seconds} s
question.sleep_detail: Sleep until tasks are over, a request is merged or a time comes: out of the list until then
question.sleep_dialog_hint: It leaves your questions until everything you pick holds. Then it wakes, the Djinn checks its facts, and it comes first.
glance.resumes_at: resumes after {time}, once its usage limit resets
plan.paused.one: {count} worker paused: stopped, its work kept until it goes on
plan.paused.other: {count} workers paused: stopped, their work kept until they go on
